info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Open Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables the management of event subscriptions in the Open Banking domain. It allows users to delete specific subscriptions based on a unique identifier, enhancing control over active event monitoring. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and developers integrating third-party services that require subscription management capabilities. Overall, it facilitates the decoupling of data consumers from event producers, ensuring a streamlined subscription lifecycle.

delete.description: This operation allows the user to delete the specified event subscription by its unique identifier. Once the deletion is confirmed, the subscription will no longer receive events.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete an event subscription identified by the specified resource ID. Please ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this operation.

204.description: The resource has been successfully deleted.

DeleteOpenBankingByParam1Request.description: A string representation of the request body for deleting event subscriptions.

DeleteOpenBankingByParam1Response_204.description: This schema represents the response for a successful deletion operation related to event subscriptions.

x-endpoint-id.description: Unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

x-runtime-app.description: The version of the application that handled the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a bearer token for authentication. A JSON Web Token (JWT) should be provided in the request Authorization header in the format: 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. The token is used to verify the identity of the user and must be securely handled.
